about_the_game:
The French Connection: The Official Digital Artbook

Complete your journey into the world of "French Connection" with the one and only official digital artbook. For everyone wanting to hold on to the magic of the game a little longer, we have gathered all the stories that couldn't be told in the main campaign.

Featuring secret character backstories, never-before-seen illustrations, and exclusive behind-the-scenes commentary from the creative team, this is a content-rich collection that no fan of "French Connection" should miss.

Highlights:

  • In-Depth Character Profiles & Fun Facts: Learn everything you ever wanted to know about the characters—their MBTI types, favorite foods, secret histories, and more!

  • Stunning High-Quality CGs: Experience the game's most beautiful and emotional moments all over again with high-resolution gallery-quality art.

  • Exclusive Unreleased Artwork: Uncover a treasure trove of B-side illustrations, initial character designs, and environmental concept art that you can only find here.

  • Creator's Commentary: Go behind the scenes with notes on every page, revealing development episodes and the artistic intent behind each piece, providing a richer appreciation for the world.

Are you ready to take the final step into the world of "French Connection"?

※ Please be aware that the content of this digital artbook is provided in Korean only.

content_descriptors.notes:
This content is the digital artbook for the visual novel, "French Connection."

The original game is a romance visual novel that includes consensual sexual scenes. This artbook contains illustrations from these adult scenes, which may feature partial nudity and suggestive imagery implying sexual activity.

However, all sensitive parts in the illustrations from the adult scenes have been censored with mosaics. There are no direct or explicit depictions of genitalia.

Furthermore, like the original game, this artbook does not contain sensitive topics such as sexual assault, non-consensual sex, drug/alcohol abuse, or self-harm.
